message.reasoning_content:
need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the case.

Facts: Defendant Ye purchased counterfeit seals (印章) from a fake seal vendor, providing the text to be engraved. He had six seals forged: company seals, financial seals, legal representative seals for two companies. He was caught, the seals were identified as counterfeit. The question: what crime label(s) apply? The list includes:

- 伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章
- 伪造、变造居民身份证
- 伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章

We need to see which matches. The seals are company seals, not state documents. So the appropriate label is "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章". The list also includes "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" which is for state documents. Not applicable.

Thus single charge: 伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章

Check if any other charges like "买卖" (selling) but he only purchased and had them made; the crime is forging (伪造) of company seals. The list includes that label.

Thus answer: [罪名]伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章<eoa>
